config.rationale: Builds directly on the best prior result (resnet18, 0.9924) by widening hidden 32→48 for ~2.25× more channel capacity, enabling class_weighting to counter the 1.63× imbalance (minority class has only 7886 samples vs 12885 for majority), and adding rotate90 augmentation to exploit tissue-pattern symmetry. LR is reduced to 3e-4 to stabilize the wider network, batch increased to 256 for smoother gradients, and weight decay raised to 5e-4 to regularize the extra parameters. Label smoothing bumped to 0.1 to further soften overconfident majority-class predictions. All other hyperparameters (depth=3, dropout=0.1, AdamW, cosine) are held at the values that produced the 0.9924 result.
